Sweets

What is in the window

From the shop window and from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Traditional sweets

Galaktoboureko, baklava, almond pie and orange pie. One guest calls the baklava with pistachios just beautiful.

Savoury pies

Cheese pie, olive pie and more in the window. One guest recommends the warm tachinopita.

Coffee

Cypriot coffee, cappuccino and flat white. A guest notes there are non dairy options for coffee.

Breakfast

Open from 7:30 every day. Guests come for a pastry, fresh orange juice and coffee in the morning.

The window and the sweets

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

On the square

Tables in the pedestrian square under the trees, next to Faneromeni school, with a view of the church.

Help choosing

Guests write that the staff take the time to explain each item and advise what to choose.

Fair prices

Several reviews mention good and reasonable prices.

Since 1952

A traditional confectionery and coffeehouse in the old town of Nicosia, by Faneromeni. Open every day from 7:30.

What guests say

Three of 141 Google reviews, 110 of them with five stars.

“A wonderful, authentic pastry shop in old town Nicosia loved by locals. A must-try for anyone with a sweet tooth! The atmosphere is nice under the trees, next to Faneromeni school!”

Google review
“Try the warm tachinopita. It's so nice. They have non dairy options for coffee. Would highly recommend”

Google review
“Very nice and traditional place. I loved the atmosphere in the shadows with locals drinking their coffee. Must try sweets! Baklava with pistachios is just beautiful! Girls who work here and so nice and helpful. You can take quick breakfast (they have some pastries) and drink good cappuccino. Recommended!”
